DOP: gaṇa m. [ ts ], 1. a multitude, a number; a group, a class, a tribe; a company, an association (of persons sharing a common purpose); esp. a company of followers attached to a teacher ; Abh 629; 1050; Vin I 42, 22 (sabbe va tayo imaṃ ~aṃ pariharissāmā ti); III 173, 10 (pakkhaṃ pariyesati ~aṃ bandhati); D II 30, 17 (yannūnāhaṃ eko ~asmā vūpakaṭṭho vihareyyan ti); M I 231, 11 (imesaṃ pi … saṅghānaṃ ~ānaṃ seyyathīdaṃ Vajjīnaṃ Mallānaṃ …); III 221, 4 (satthā ~aṃ anusāsituṃ arahatī ti); Th 1051 (na ~ena purakkhato care … ~aṃ na rocaye); Ja III 357, 19* (~aṃ vā parihare dhīro eko vā pi paribbaje); IV 450, 11* (parivāritā accharāsaṃ ~ena); VI 313, 10* (taṃ [ṭhānaṃ] nāgakaññācaritaṃ ~ena; 313, 19´ : caritaṃ ~enā ti taṃ nāgakaññānaṃ ~ena caritaṃ); Nidd I 77, 9 (satthāraṃ gaṇhāti dhammakkhānaṃ gaṇhāti ~aṃ gaṇhāti diṭṭhiṃ gaṇhāti …); Ap 317, 17 (ete sabbe samāgantvā ~aṃ bandhāma ekato); Bv 5:8 (mahāvīro ovadī titthiye ~e); Cp 2:4:3 (anapekkhā kule ~e; Cp-a 133, 28 : kule ti upaṭṭhākakule, ~e ti tāpasagaṇe); Mil 191, 3 foll. (mahiyā ~ā vattanti … tesaṃ tesaṃ rahassaṃ tesu tesu ~esu yeva carati avasesānaṃ pihitaṃ); Vism 93, 22 (tena ~aṃ pahāya yattha naṃ na jānanti tattha ekakena caritabbaṃ); Sv 280, 11 (pubbe nagarassa anto agaṇā bahi nikkhamitvā °-taṃ pattā ti gaṇībhūtā, Be, Se so; Ce, Ee °-sampannā ti) ≠ Ps III 416, 3 ( eds ~ā sampannā ti); Ps IV 158, 7 (~o ti nānājanasamodhānaṃ); Mp IV 15, 21 (~ena saddhiṃ yuddhaṃ nāma bhāriyaṃ eko pi moghappahāro nāma natthi); Ud-a 349, 25 (dve pūgā ti dve ~ā); Sadd 536, 23 (eko dve ti ādinā gaṇetabbo ti ~o); — ifc see ariya-, ūhanīyarūpa- ( sv ūhati ), kākola-, tārā-, dhamma- ( sv dhamma 1 ), nekavassa- ( sv neka ), miga-, sakuṇa-; — 2. a group within a Buddhist saṅgha ; an assemblage of bhikkhu s for carrying out formal acts, a quorum ; Abh 1050; Vin I 58, 33 foll. (bhikkhū duvaggena pi tivaggena pi ~ena upasampādenti … na bhikkhave ūnadasavaggena ~ena upasampādetabbo); 197, 31 (anujānāmi bhikkhave evarūpesu paccantimesu janapadesu vinayadharapañcamena ~ena upasampadaṃ); II 15, 31 (saṅghaṃ vā ~aṃ vā puggalaṃ vā nimantetukāmo); IV 216, 11 (n’ ev’ attanā paṭicodesi na ~assa ārocesī ti); 283, 28 (yā pana bhikkhunī ~assa cīvaralābhaṃ antarāyaṃ kareyya …; 283, 31 : ~o nāma bhikkhunīsaṅgho vuccati); 316, 17 (anapaloketvā saṅghaṃ vā ~aṃ vā; 316, 26 : saṅgho nāma bhikkhunī-saṅgho vuccati ~o nāma sambahulā bhikkhuniyo vuccanti); Vism 93, 24 (~o ti suttantikagaṇo vā ābhidhammikagaṇo vā); Sp 339, 29 (dīghabhāṇakādi-bhedassa pana ~assa ekapuggalassa vā); 814, 7 (tehi ~o na pūrati gaṇapūrako ca animantito tena ~o bhijjatī ti); 1170, 21 foll. (ūne ~e ti ettha ~o ti cattāro vā atirekā vā); Mhv 34:87 (bhikkhūnīnaṃ ~assa); Sadd 536, 10 (~o ti bhikkhusamūho); — ifc see ābhidhammika-, suttantika-; — 3. ( gr.t.t. ) a series of roots or words following the same rule and called after the first word of the series ; Sadd 502, 12* (Kaccāyane vutto gahādīnaṃ ~o visuṃ); 518, 17* (pavakkhāmi … curādikagaṇaṃ nāma nāmato aṭṭhamaṃ ~aṃ); — ifc see dhātu-, bhuvādi-; — gaṇānaṃ in Ee at M III 1, 16 is wr for gaṇakānaṃ ( Be, Ce, Se so ); — see also ekagaṇika ( sv eka ), tegaṇika, digaṇika ( sv dvi ), bhuvādigaṇika; — °-m- aggena , ind. , by groups ;? Vin I 117, 24 (anujānāmi bhikkhave tadahuposathe gaṇamaggena vā gaṇetuṃ salākaṃ vā gahetun ti, Ee so, perhaps wr; Be, Ce nāmaggena; Se nāmamattena); — °’- ārāma , mfn. , finding pleasure in a company ; M III 110, 17 (~o gaṇarato); A III 422, 28 foll. (~o gaṇarato ~-taṃ anuyutto; Mp III 410, 17 : suttantika-gaṇādisu pana gaṇesu attano vā parisasaṅkhāte gaṇe ramatī ti ~o); Vism 107, 11 (~-tā); — ° āvavassagga , m. , see below ; — °- ohīyana , gaṇamhā-ohīyana, n. , falling behind the group, being left behind ; Sp 275, 13 ( in long cpd : …-vippavāsagaṇa-ohīyanāpattīhi, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee wr -ohiyanāpattīhi); 1392, 6 ( in long cpd : -nadīpāragaṇamhā-ohīyanalakkhaṇena, Be, Ce so; Ee wr -gaṇhamhā-; Se -gaṇamhā-ohiyyana-); — gaṇa-ṅ- gaṇū̆pāhanā ( and °-ṅ-gaṇa-upāhanā), f. [ cf BHS gaṇaguṇa], sandal(s) with a sole of several layers ; Vin I 185, 26 (na ~ā dhāretabbā, Ce, Ee, Se so; Be guṇaṅguṇūpāhanā; Sp 1083, 22 : tigunā ti tipaṭalā, ~ā ti catupaṭalato paṭṭhāya vuccati, Ce, Ee, Se so; Be guṇaṅguṇ-); 196, 1 (app eva nāma bhagavā Avantdakkhiṇāpathe ~aṃ anujāneyya, Ce, Ee, Se so; Be guṇaṅguṇūpāhanaṃ); Ps III 411, 15 (paṭaliyo ti ~ā, Be so; Se gaṇaṅgaṇa-upāhanā; Ce aṭaliyo ti gaṇaṅgaṇa-upāhanā; Ee aṭaliyo ti gaṇaṅgaṇa-ūpāhanā) = Spk I 346, 1 ( Be so; Ce, Ee, Se aṭaliyo ti ~ā); Vin-vn 3089 (gaṇaṅgaṇa-upāhanā); — °- cāri(n) , mfn. , moving in a group or crowd ; Ja III 477, 24* (makkhikā ~inī aṅgāre vāsaṃ kappeyyuṃ); IV 347, 24* (kumbhīlakā sakuṇakā saṅghino ~ino); — °- pūra , mfn. , (one) who makes up the number ; Vin-vn 2606 (’saṃvāsapuggalaṃ ~aṃ karontassa); — °- pūraka , mfn. , (one) who makes up the number, completes the quorum ; Vin I 143, 12 (anussāvessāmi vā ~o vā bhavissāmī ti); Sp 814, 20 (sesānaṃ ~-ttā); 1107, 20 (sace purimikāya upagatā cattāro vā honti tayo vā … itare ~e katvā kaṭhinaṃ attharitabbaṃ); Vin-vn 2607; — °- bandha , m. , 1. joining together in a group (to do something) ; Spk II 178, 13 (aññe pi pāpicchā ~ena kulesu viññāpetvā); — 2. one who belongs to a group ; Ja V 466, 11 (sesā ~ā macchamaṃsādīni khādantā, Be, Se so; Ce, Ee sesagaṇabandhā); — °- bandhana , n. , joining together in a group (to do something); a joint endeavour ; Ja V 427, 27´ (chaṇakāle … suvaṇṇakārā ~ena … maṇḍapaṃ kāretvā … surāpānaṃ ārabhiṃsu, Ce so; Ee ~e; Be, Se °-bandhena); Dhp-a II 160, 1 (ekavīthivāsino manussā samaggā hutvā ~ena dānaṃ datvā, Ce, Ee so; Be, Se °-bandhena); — °- bandhika , ( and °-bandhiya), n. ( or mfn. ?), (connected with) joining together in a group ;? acquiring a following ;? Vin I 59, 28 (atilahuṃ kho tvaṃ moghapurisa bāhullāya āvatto yad idaṃ ~aṃ; Sp 984, 20 : gaṇabandho etassa bāhullassa atthī ti ~aṃ bāhullaṃ) quoted Ud-a 266, 18 ( eds °-bandhiyaṃ); — °- bhojana , n. , receiving and eating food in a group ; Vin IV 71, 33 (~e pācittiyan ti; 74, 30 : yattha cattāro bhikkhū pañcannaṃ bhojanānaṃ aññatarena bhojanena nimantitā bhuñjanti etaṃ ~aṃ nāma; Sp 812, 3 : ~e ti gaṇassa bhojane, idha gaṇo nāma cattāro bhikkhū ādiṃ katvā taduttariṃ bhikkhū adhippetā); Utt-vn 788; — °- rāja , mfn. , having the group as ruler ; Sp 212, 22 (mayaṃ hi Licchavīnaṃ ~ūnaṃ rajje vasāma); Ps III 16, 20 (~āno hi te, tasmā uppannaṃ kiccaṃ ekassa vasena na chijjati, sabbesaṃ chando laddhuṃ vaṭṭati); — °- va(t) , mfn. , attended by a company ; Pj II 422, 21 (saṅghino ti °-vanto); Nidd-a II 28, 20 (gaṇigaṇī ti °-vantānaṃ atīva °-vā); Sadd 145, 3* (guṇavā °-vā c’ eva balavā yasavā tathā); — gaṇā-vavassagga , m. [gaṇa + vavassagga with rhythmical lengthening? ], giving up the group, renouncing company ; Nidd I 145, 3 (kathaṃ ~’-atthena eko pubbe caritvāna); — °- vassika , mfn. , used for several years ; Sn 279 (gūthakūpo yathā assa sampuṇṇo ~o; Pj II 310, 26 : ~o anekavassiko bahūni vassāni mukhato gūthena pūriyamāno); — °- saṅgaṇikā , f. , association with groups; the society of companies of people ; Sp 222, 4 (asaṃvare ṭhitassa attā ~āya c’ eva kilesasaṅgaṇikāya ca saṃvattati); Spk III 122, 16 (yogāvacaro … kāyavivekena ~aṃ [vijjhati]); Dhp-a I 162, 10 ; Ud-a 231, 19 (~aṃ pahāya vivittavāso kāyaviveko nāma); — °- saṅghavārī in Ee at S I 127, 3* is wr for °-saṅghacārī ( Be, Ce so ); — °- satthāraka , m. , the teacher of a group ; Ap 213, 24 (~o ahaṃ, Be so; Ce gaṇasatthā ahos’ ahaṃ; Ee wr gaṇasantharako; Se gaṇasanthārako); — agaṇa , mfn. , not in a group ; Sv 280, 10 (pubbe nagarassa anto ~ā bahi nikkhamitvā gaṇasampannā ti) ≠ Ps III 416, 3 ; — sagaṇa , mfn. , with a group, with a following ; Ap-a 431,19 (Vipassiṃ bhagavantaṃ ~aṃ disvā); — see also anekavassagaṇika ( sv eka ), nvassagaṇika ( sv neka ).
